intro: Connect this character to live chat platforms. Each link stores the routing key Synapse uses to load this card when messages arrive from that channel.

form.botNamePlaceholder: How the bot appears on this platform

error.displayNameRequired: Enter a display name for this connection.
error.botNameRequired: Enter the bot or service account name for this platform.

discord.title: Discord
discord.subtitle: Link a Discord server (guild) so the Chimera bot can route chat to this character.
discord.hint: Ingest uses the guild id as ChannelId (same as the Discord connector). Add that server id here and ensure your bot process allows this guild in DiscordSettings:GuildIds. How to enable Developer Mode
discord.channelIdHint: Right‑click the server icon → Copy Server ID (Developer Mode on).
discord.validationError: Use a numeric guild id (17–20 digits). Enable Developer Mode → Copy Server ID.

twitch.title: Twitch
twitch.subtitle: Link a Twitch channel so chat ingest can map to this character (broadcaster login or id).
twitch.hint: Store the same ChannelId your Twitch connector sends (often the channel login in lowercase or numeric user id). Must match TwitchSettings / bot scope for that channel.
twitch.channelIdHint: Must match the identifier used in ChatMessage.ChannelId for Twitch.
twitch.validationError: Use 1–100 characters: letters, digits, _ and - only.

kick.title: Kick
kick.subtitle: Link a Kick channel for routing live chat to this character.
kick.hint: Use the channel slug or id your Kick connector publishes as ChannelId in the unified chat message.
kick.channelIdHint: Same value as ingest ChannelId from the Kick connector.
kick.validationError: Use 1–100 characters: letters, digits, _ and - only.

vk_video.title: VK Video
vk_video.subtitle: Link a VK Video (live) context so stream chat routes to this character.
vk_video.hint: Use the stable channel or owner id string your VK connector sets as ChannelId for live comments.
vk_video.channelIdHint: Must match ChatMessage.ChannelId from the VK Video ingest path.
vk_video.validationError: Use 1–100 characters: letters, digits, _ and - only.
